We Make Your Game With You

Queer-led codevelopment studio. We assemble the right indie talent, manage the contractors, and ship bespoke work for a flat price. You get a team without the overhead.

hi@bigteam.ca

Who We Are

We're friends of friends of friends who make videogames — a queer-led network of indie developers, artists, and designers. When you work with bigTEAM, you get a curated squad hand-picked for your project, not whoever's on the bench.

We handle the messy parts: sourcing contractors, managing timelines, and making sure everyone gets paid. You get one flat price and one point of contact. Bring us your own talent, or let us find the perfect fit.

Why Work With Us

Diverse teams bring perspectives that funders and players are looking for. Many funding bodies explicitly prioritize underrepresented voices — we help you meet those criteria and tell that story authentically.

Flat Price

No surprise invoices. One agreed-upon fee covers the whole engagement.

We Manage Risk

Contractor falls through? Scope creeps? That's on us, not you.

Use Your People or Ours

Have a favourite artist? Bring them. Need a whole team built from scratch? We got you.

Grant-Friendly

We understand what funders want to see — from Creative BC to the CMF.
